more.def: A very high area of land, much taller than a hill.
examples: It took the climbers three days to reach the top of the mountain.
The mountain was hidden in clouds.
A cold stream runs down the side of the mountain.

easy.def: The side of a mountain.
examples: We hiked up the mountainside.
Snow covers the mountainside.
A goat walked on the mountainside.

more.def: The sloping side of a mountain.
examples: We hiked up the steep mountainside.
Snow covered the mountainside all winter.
Mountain goats climbed along the rocky mountainside.

easy.def: To feel very sad because someone has died.
examples: We mourn our old cat.
The family mourned for a week.
They mourn their friend.

more.def: To feel deep sadness and show it after a person or pet has died.
examples: The whole town came together to mourn the loss of their kind neighbor.
We mourned our old dog, but we also shared happy memories of him.
The family mourned quietly and held each other close.

easy.def: A small animal with a long tail.
examples: A mouse ran under the bed.
The cat chased the mouse.
The mouse ate the cheese.

more.def: A small furry animal with a pointed nose, small ears and a long thin tail.
examples: A tiny mouse nibbled on seeds in the barn.
Mice can squeeze through very small holes.
The owl swooped down to catch a mouse.

easy.def: A small tool you move with your hand to use a computer.
examples: Click the mouse.
I move the mouse.
The mouse is by the computer.

more.def: A small device that you move by hand to point and click on a computer screen.
examples: I clicked the mouse to open the game.
He moved the mouse to the button on the screen.
A wireless mouse has no cord.

easy.def: A light, fluffy food that is sweet.
examples: We had chocolate mousse.
The mousse is soft.
I ate a mousse.

more.def: A light, soft food made with whipped cream or egg whites, often a sweet dessert.
examples: We had chocolate mousse for dessert.
The mousse was smooth and fluffy.
She spooned berry mousse into small cups.

easy.def: The hair that grows above a man's lip.
examples: Grandpa has a moustache.
The man has a big moustache.
The moustache is gray.

more.def: The strip of hair that some men grow between their nose and mouth.
examples: Grandpa has a bushy gray moustache.
The actor wore a fake moustache.
He trimmed his moustache with scissors.

easy.def: The part of your face you eat with.
examples: Open your mouth.
The baby put the toy in her mouth.
My mouth is full.

more.def: The opening in the face that is used for eating and speaking.
examples: Open your mouth wide and say ahh.
The hippo opened its huge mouth.
She covered her mouth when she yawned.

easy.def: The place where a river ends.
examples: The ship sailed to the mouth of the river.
A town sits at the mouth of the river.
Birds gather at the river's mouth.

more.def: The place where a river flows into the sea or a lake.
examples: A city grew at the mouth of the river.
Many fish live at the mouth of the river.
We walked to the mouth of the stream.

easy.def: As much food as you can fit in your mouth.
examples: Take a mouthful.
A big mouthful of soup.
I ate a mouthful.

more.def: The amount of food or drink that fills your mouth, or a word that is long and hard to say.
examples: Take a small mouthful and chew slowly.
He swallowed a big mouthful of milk.
"Supercalifragilistic" is a mouthful to say.

easy.def: To go from one place to another.
examples: Do not move.
The snail moves slowly.
She moved her chair.

more.def: To change position or place, or to make something change its position.
examples: The clouds move across the sky in the wind.
Please move your bag so I can sit down.
The dancers moved in time with the music.

easy.def: To go live in a new home.
examples: We move next week.
They moved to a new town.
She moved away.

more.def: To leave your home and go to live in a new place.
examples: My family moved to a new town last summer.
They are moving to a bigger house near the park.
Our neighbors moved away, and new ones came.

easy.def: Moving from one place to another.
examples: I saw movement in the grass.
The movement of the clock hands is slow.
Dancers use graceful movements.

more.def: The act of moving, or a way in which a person or thing moves.
examples: We saw some movement in the bushes.
The dancer's movements were smooth and graceful.
The movement of the planets is very slow.

easy.def: A group of people working together for a cause.
examples: The movement helped clean the river.
They joined the movement.
A big movement for kindness.

more.def: A group of people who work together to change something.
examples: The movement for clean air began many years ago.
Many people joined the movement to protect the forests.
The students started a movement to recycle more.

easy.def: A person who helps carry your things when you move.
examples: The movers carried the sofa.
The movers are here.
A mover lifted the box.

more.def: A person whose job is to carry furniture and boxes from one home to another when people move.
examples: The movers carried the sofa and boxes into the truck.
We hired movers to help us move to the new house.
The movers wrapped the lamps in blankets.

easy.def: A story you watch on a screen.
examples: We watched a movie.
The movie was funny.
I like movies about animals.

more.def: A story told with moving pictures and sound, shown in a theater or on a screen.
examples: We saw a movie about dinosaurs at the theater.
The movie was long, so we took a break to eat popcorn.
Many movies are made from favorite books.

easy.def: To cut grass.
examples: Dad mows the lawn.
I mowed the grass.
We mow on Saturday.

more.def: To cut grass with a machine or a tool.
examples: Dad mows the lawn every Saturday.
I mowed the grass in the front yard.
The farmer mowed the hay field before it rained.

easy.def: A machine that cuts grass.
examples: Dad used the mower.
The mower is loud.
A lawn mower cuts grass.

more.def: A machine with sharp blades that cuts grass on a lawn or a field.
examples: Dad pushed the mower across the lawn on Saturday.
The mower made a loud noise.
A ride-on mower cut the big field.
